subject: Physics
q: Two capacitors C₁ and C₂ have an equivalent capacitance of 10 μF when connected in parallel. When each is separately connected to the same 1 V source, the energy stored in C₂ is four times that stored in C₁. What is their equivalent capacitance in series?
hint: At the same voltage, stored energy is proportional to capacitance.
solution: From C₁ + C₂ = 10 μF and U = CV²/2, the energy condition gives C₂ = 4C₁. Thus C₁ = 2 μF and C₂ = 8 μF. In series, C_eq = C₁C₂/(C₁ + C₂) = 16/10 = 1.6 μF.
